title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Fleet Specification Sheet
content:
The published specifications of each Bluegate Moving Truck Rental class: usable cargo volume, maximum payload, whether a pull-out loading ramp is fitted, seats in the cab including the driver, whether the vehicle has a towing hitch for a rented trailer or auto transport, whether 24-hour roadside assistance is included, and how a rental interrupted by mechanical breakdown is credited.

## Cargo and cab

| Vehicle class | Cargo volume (cubic feet) | Maximum payload (pounds) | Loading ramp | Seats incl. driver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 76 | 1800 | No | 3 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 245 | 3500 | No | 2 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 402 | 2810 | No | 3 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 764 | 6385 | Yes | 3 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 1016 | 5700 | Yes | 3 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 1682 | 9844 | Yes | 3 |

## Equipment and road service

| Vehicle class | Towing hitch | 24-hour roadside assistance | Breakdown credit basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | Yes | Included | Full period base rate |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | No | Included | Full period base rate |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | Yes | Included | Full period base rate |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | Yes | Included | Full period base rate |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | Yes | Included | Full period base rate |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | Yes | Included | Full period base rate |

## Notes on the sheet

- The Bluegate Cargo Van is the only class without a towing hitch and the only one with two seats.
- Payload does not rise with cargo volume in every step: the Bluegate Cargo Van (3500 pounds) carries more than the larger-volume Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck (2810 pounds), and the Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck (6385 pounds) carries more than the Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck (5700 pounds).
- A loading ramp is fitted on the 15 ft, 20 ft and 26 ft trucks only.
